base_rule: Apply these commercial rules to the requested return or refund action. Most products can be returned within 30 days of receipt under Amazon.nl's voluntary returns guarantee. Products must be returned in the same condition in which they were received: new, unused, and complete; used products must not have additional signs of use or damage. Consumers also have a separate statutory right of withdrawal within 14 days without giving a reason. Furthermore, consumers have statutory rights for defective products, allowing complaints for incorrect, damaged, or defective products within two years of receipt (remedies include repair, replacement, price reduction, or refund where legally applicable). Customised products are generally not returnable under the voluntary guarantee, unless they are damaged, defective upon arrival, materially different, or contain a seller-caused error. Certain products are strictly excluded from returns: unsealed health or hygiene products, unsealed audio/video recordings or software, products tailored specifically to personal needs, certain digital content supplied without a tangible medium, perishable goods, fully provided services, and newspapers/magazines. Refunds are generally issued through the original payment method within a maximum of 14 days. Return costs depend on the product: free returns apply to fashion products (clothing, shoes, handbags, jewelry, watches) which may be tried on as in a shop, and to defective/damaged items; otherwise, return costs may apply.

The large bag must fit 56 x 45 x 25 cm including handles and wheels, weigh at most 15 kg, be liftable and carryable by the passenger, and have confirmed cabin space. At most one small and one large bag are allowed. Hold baggage: each passenger must stay within their own purchased weight allowance or pay the excess-weight charge; sharing allowances is not included in the base rule. Each piece must comply with dimensions and weigh at most 32 kg. Flight changes: a voluntary route change to an available flight requires the change fee and any fare increase; a lower fare does not create a refund. Changes through customer services require at least two hours before the earlier of the original and proposed departures. Inclusive Plus changes must also be at least 24 hours after purchase. Name changes: correcting a name or transferring the booking to another passenger requires the name-change fee. Identity, booking authorization and consent checks must pass, and ticket resale is prohibited. Seating: selecting an available Up Front seat requires its selection fee unless that selection has already been paid for. This rule does not authorize a free Extra Legroom upgrade. Bag-count, physical baggage limits, availability, change deadlines, identity checks, consent, the resale prohibition and fare-increase payments are mandatory in every condition. Refunds: voluntary cancellation does not entitle the customer to a commercial booking refund under the base rule. For any commercial cancellation refund that is authorized, retain the applicable cancellation fee; for the online GBP cases here that fee is GBP 49. Cancel the whole booking, verify the booker and consent, use the available original payment method, and act at least two hours before the first scheduled departure. These processing requirements and retention of the cancellation fee cannot be waived. Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights are separate and must be honored; this scoped rule does not remove them.

title: Hold-bag weight sharing on one booking
facts_text: We are two adults travelling on the same easyJet flight with standard fares. We are on the same booking. Each of us has purchased one 23 kg hold-bag allowance. My one bag weighs 27 kg and the other passenger's one bag weighs 19 kg, totaling 46 kg against 46 kg purchased. Both bags meet the size limits and contain only ordinary permitted items. Bag drop is open and there is no flight disruption.
request: Please accept my 27 kg bag using the other passenger's unused allowance without charging an excess-weight fee.

published_policy.text: Scoped summary of published easyJet provisions for these cases: one small cabin bag is included; paid large-bag allowances and eligible Plus/Inclusive Plus benefits permit an additional compliant bag, subject to applicable booking and space rules. Hold allowances may be pooled within the same booking; excess weight beyond the applicable allowance is charged and a piece cannot exceed 32 kg. Voluntary flight changes normally incur a fee and fare increase. Inclusive Plus route changes within one day either side of the original date waive the change fee but retain any fare increase. Its changes cannot occur in the first 24 hours after purchase; customer-services changes require at least two hours before the earlier departure. Genuine spelling corrections for the same person are free: up to three characters online/app, otherwise contact customer services. A passenger replacement requires the name-change fee; resale is prohibited. Seat selection normally costs a fee; Inclusive Plus includes an available Up Front seat and active Plus members have included seat selection. These benefits do not override physical limits, availability, identity or consent checks. Voluntary cancellation of the whole booking within 24 hours normally permits a booking refund minus the cancellation fee, but cannot be processed less than two hours before the first scheduled departure. Online cancellation in GBP has a GBP 49 fee. Ordinary cancellation after 24 hours does not qualify for that refund. Government-tax claims remain separate; illness, bereavement and disruption provisions are outside these cases. Refunds normally go to the verified booker using the original payment method. This is a scoped paraphrase, not the complete official terms.

adaptation_note: The provider is real; customer cases are synthetic. Every active airline core receives the same whole policy text for a given condition. Removing genuine-typo or fare benefits is an experimental intervention, not a statement of official easyJet practice. Physical, timing, identity and availability requirements are fixed. The published summary is separate, source-based and limited to these cases. No statutory right or safety obligation is manipulated. For refunds, strict removes the source 24-hour commercial refund provision, exception retains that explicit window, and ambiguous substitutes discretion over refund eligibility. Cancellation fees, the two-hour cutoff and processing checks stay fixed. Tax refunds and statutory rights are not manipulated. All refund cases are ordinary voluntary cancellations with no illness, bereavement, disruption or extras.

base_rule: Apply these commercial rules to the requested action. For a flexible-rate booking, cancellation or amendment before 15:00 local time on the day before arrival receives a full refund; after that deadline, no refund is provided. A non-refundable-rate booking cannot be cancelled or amended and receives no refund in case of cancellation or no-show. At check-in, the guest must present the booking confirmation and valid photo identification; if satisfactory identification cannot be provided, the booking is terminated without refund.

If Uber Eats or the restaurant cancels, refund the full order, including delivery and service fees. The sources reviewed here do not establish a universal refund entitlement, item-claim deadline, or delivery-delay threshold for every order. This is a scoped paraphrase, not the complete terms or order-specific support guidance.
published_policy.classification_note: Draft classification: the reviewed public materials direct customers to personalized support but do not establish universal order-refund thresholds. The strict, exception, and ambiguous variants are researcher-authored experimental interventions, not three official Uber Eats policies.

adaptation_note: The real provider is Uber Eats, and customer cases are synthetic. The published-policy summary is scoped to the official sources listed above. Experimental order/refund rules are researcher-authored: strict disallows discretionary deadline extensions, exception allows only the specified documented emergency extension, and ambiguous leaves that extension to agent judgment. Applicable legal and food-safety rights are not manipulated.
title: Broken food seal and leaking package raise a safety concern
facts_text: I verified my account and order. The chicken curry was delivered about an hour ago. Its tamper-evident seal is broken and the container is leaking. I am concerned the food may not be safe, so I have not eaten it. I do not have a photo, but the order and delivery are in my account.
request: Please tell me not to eat it if it may be unsafe, escalate the report to the food-safety team, and refund the affected dish and its tax.

strict.reason: The customer reports a credible food-safety concern and damaged food packaging. Safety advice and escalation are required without a photo, and the timely verified damage report qualifies for the affected-item refund.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The report is timely, so the deadline exception is not needed; all requested actions follow from the verified damage and food-safety concern.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The item-damage claim is timely and the safety concern requires escalation; discretionary language about late claims does not change either result.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Treat this as both a damaged-item claim and a food-safety report. Confirm that the policy's verified-damage requirement is satisfied by the account delivery record and customer report without improperly making a photo mandatory.
